create_nonefilter_logger: create a NoneFilter logger that filters out None values before forwarding to another logger
create_timefilter_logger: create a TimeFilter logger that writes to another logger at a specified time interval in seconds
create_keyfilter_logger: create a KeyFilter logger that keeps or drops specific keys from logged data before forwarding
create_gatedfilter_periodic: create a GatedFilter logger that writes periodically at fixed intervals using the periodic class method
create_gatedfilter_logarithmic: create a GatedFilter logger that writes at logarithmically spaced intervals using the logarithmic class method
